params.body:
## Why

Three things from Shane's staging round on the vehicle sheet, after #260 and #271. All three are
about the sheet a dealer sees before they have typed anything: a switch glued to the field above it,
a warranty pane that no longer looks attached to the tabs it belongs to, and five amount boxes that
read `€ 0.00` on a brand new sheet, which looks filled in when it is empty.

## What changed, per item

### 1. LOCATIE: the switch gets the rhythm of the form

`voertuig plaatsen op de showroom slides` sat in a `.ui-field` *after* the `ui-form-grid`. A
`.ui-field` only carries `margin-bottom`, so outside the grid it had no space above it at all and
touched the bottom edge of the Locatie select.

It is now a cell *inside* the same grid. That gives it the grid's own row gap (18px from 768px up,
12px below) and lines it up with the left column, instead of hanging loose underneath. Checked at
1280 and 390.

While taking the screenshots a second, real defect showed up in the same spot: on the **create**
sheet the switch was not a switch at all. The bought wizard theme carries
`.wizard > .content > .body label { display: inline-block }`, which is more specific than
`.ui-switch`, so the toggle fell back to a bare checkbox with the track drawn on top of the label.
Only when adding a vehicle, because the edit sheet is a tab panel and not a wizard. One scoped rule
in `refresh.css` puts the `inline-flex` back; the wizard stylesheet itself is untouched.

### 2. GARANTIE: the pane hangs from its tabs again

Since `ui-warranty-box--plain` dropped the frame (#271), "Tot en met datum" / "Of tot kilometerstand"
floated free of the Garantie / Verlengde waarborg switch above them. The frame is not coming back;
instead the gap under the tabs is tighter (8px to 4px) and the pane gets a light left rule with a
12px indent, so it reads as belonging to the selected segment.

Everything is under the `--plain` modifier, so the offer and order modals (`ui-warranty-box` without
it) are untouched. Proven, not claimed: the rendered offer modal is **byte-identical** before and
after at 1280 and 390 (`cmp` on the two PNGs), and the only difference in the rendered HTML is the
CSRF token and the fixture's vehicle id.

### 3. Prices: an empty amount shows empty

The price columns of `vehicles` carry a `0` default (`purchase_price`, `repairs_price`,
`retail_price`, `trade_price` are `float DEFAULT 0`; `export_price` is `NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`), and a
fresh sheet is a draft row, so every amount printed a formatted `0.00` before a dealer had typed a
thing.

The rule, in one helper (`Custom::priceInput($value, $sheetSaved)`): on a sheet that was never saved
(`is_complete = 0`) a null or zero amount renders as an empty input with a muted `0.00` placeholder.
On a saved sheet nothing changes at all: a `0.00` somebody really stored keeps showing `0.00`.

Amounts on the sheet, and what each one does:

| field | column default | before | now |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `purchase_price` (Aankoopprijs) | `DEFAULT 0` | `0.00` | empty on a fresh sheet, `0.00` once saved |
| `repairs_price` (Reparatiekosten) | `DEFAULT 0` | `0.00` | empty on a fresh sheet, `0.00` once saved |
| `total_price` (Totaal aankoop, computed, disabled) | derived | `0.00` | empty on a fresh sheet |
| `retail_price` (Verkoopprijs) | `DEFAULT 0` | `0.00` | empty on a fresh sheet, `0.00` once saved |
| `trade_price` (Collega "Samen Sterk") | `DEFAULT 0` | `0.00` | empty on a fresh sheet, `0.00` once saved |
| `export_price` (Interne handelsprijs, bidding only) | `NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` | `0` | empty on a fresh sheet, still `0` (not `0.00`) once saved |
| `road_tax_vlaanderen` / `_wallonie` / `_brussel` | `DEFAULT NULL` | already empty | unchanged |
| `registration_tax_vlaanderen` / `_wallonie` / `_brussel` | `DEFAULT NULL` | already empty | unchanged |
| `catalog_price` (read-only text) | `DEFAULT NULL` | `onbekend` when 0 | unchanged |

Today's behaviour is not uniform, so each field is pinned to what it does today rather than
unified: the six tax amounts already rendered empty (their columns are nullable) and stay exactly as
they were, and `export_price` keeps printing a bare `0` on a saved sheet instead of `0.00`.

### What the empty-price rule does and does not change

**Does not change what is stored.** An untouched box used to post `"0.00"` and now posts `""`. One
place decides what that means: `OwnStockService::normaliseAmounts()`, with
`AMOUNTS_ZERO_WHEN_EMPTY` as the list. It runs in `VehicleRequest::prepareForValidation()` (the
classic form), in `VehicleForm::toBackendArray()` (the Livewire sheet) and again at the top of
`finalizeCreate` / `finalizeEdit`, so the write is normalised regardless of the caller. Empty stays
`0`, never `null`, for exactly the five columns above. The tax amounts are deliberately not in the
list: their columns are `DEFAULT NULL`, they already posted empty, and pinning them to 0 would
change what the sheet stores today.

`VehicleRequest` validates `export_price` as `required`, which an empty string fails; normalising
before validation is what keeps that rule satisfied. That also closes a latent gap on the Livewire
sheet, which already blanked `export_price` when it was 0 (business rule S1-5.10) and would have
been rejected by its own validation.

**Does not change the JS.** The `onfocus` / `onchange` / `onblur` handlers on the price inputs, the
`price_input` / `required` class hooks, `vehicle.totalPrice()` and the `prices_error` logic are all
untouched, so the offer and order documents keep reading the same numbers.

**Test.** `tests/Feature/VehicleSheetEmptyAmountTest` posts the whole sheet twice through
`ownvehicle.store`, once with `"0.00"` in every amount (yesterday's untouched form) and once with
`""` (today's), and asserts the two rows are the same row. Checked by mutation: removing the
normalisation makes it fail. Plus a unit-level test of the normaliser and of the display rule.

## Screenshots

Before/after at 1280 and 390 for the three sections plus the offer modal, in the scratchpad as
`sheet2-{before,after}-{locatie,garantie,prijzen,offer}-{1280,390}.png`. Rendered from the real
create sheet of a fresh draft vehicle.

- `locatie`: the switch moves down by a row gap, and is a switch again instead of a bare checkbox.
- `garantie`: the pane sits closer under the tabs, with a light rule down its left edge.
- `prijzen`: `0.00` in five boxes becomes a muted placeholder in five empty boxes.
- `offer`: identical, byte for byte, at both widths.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean (`public/build` untracked, not committed).
- `phpunit --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle|Price|Offer|Order'`:
  254 tests, everything green except the five `IntegrationSmokeTest` cases that need real third
  party credentials; those fail identically on an unmodified tree here.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: three small things from the staging round
